infoLinks.urlText: Service changes for Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 26 January, ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water. 
 
F5 Neutral Bay services will not run to/from Circular Quay while exclusion zones are in effect. 
 
From 11.45am to 12.45pm, services will run in a to/from Kirribilli only.  
 
From 7pm to 10pm, services will not run. The last service will leave Circular Quay at 6.25pm. 
 
Services will resume with additional late-night ferries leaving Circular Quay at 10pm and 10.30pm. 
 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 21 and Thursday 22 January  
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trackwork buses do not leave from Martin Place Station.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between South Coast Line stations and Central, platforms 1-14.
  • Change at Central for buses to Kings Cross, Edgecliff and Bondi Junction or metro services to Martin Place.

  • Nightly from 10.40pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make extra stops at Arncliffe and Sydenham.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes

20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)

36T4 Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Maitland school buses - service changes
infoLinks.content:
From 27 January 2026, timetable and route path changes will take effect on some Maitland school bus services and regular route services.
 
Additional information:
  • A new route 2802 service will connect students directly from Maitland High School to High St Maitland, where it will become a new 185 service connecting students and the broader community to Lorn, Bolwarra, Bolwarra Heights and Largs.
  • An altered 1471 service will connect Maitland Christian School and Hunter Valley Grammar School students with Chisholm.
  • An altered 2396 service will replace route 0342 for Tenambit Public School students.
  • An altered 0342 service will no longer service Tenambit Public School and will now service Maitland Grossman High School students, getting students home to Metford earlier.
  • Additional weekend services for the 185 service – connecting Largs and Maitland via Bolwarra, Bolwarra Heights and Lorn.
Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.
